body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Vuzix introduced the world's first fashionable sunglass-style video eyewear 'Wrap 920AV' with revolutionary see-thru quantum optics at 2009 CES.

The stylish Wrap 920AV functions with any media playing device with a video output and projects a virtual 60-inch screen, as viewed from 9-feet. The state-of-the-art lens technology also allows users for the first time to view 3D video content while seeing and interacting with the real world.
